indexForFilter.title: Add an index for the filter on {{table}}
indexForFilter.why: A scan of {{table}} reads {{examined}} rows but keeps only {{kept}} ({{selectivity}}). An index on {{columns}} lets the server read just the rows it needs.

indexResidualFilter.title: Extend the index on {{table}} to cover {{columns}}
indexResidualFilter.why: The index {{usedIndex}} finds {{examined}} rows, then a filter keeps only {{kept}}. An index on {{columns}} would filter inside the index.

indexForSort.title: Add an index that returns {{table}} already sorted
indexForSort.why: A sort of {{rows}} rows is needed. An index on {{columns}} returns rows in the requested order and can remove the sort.

nestedLoopInnerScan.title: The inner side of a nested loop is scanned {{loops}} times
nestedLoopInnerScan.why: The inner input runs {{loops}} times. An index on the join column of the inner table, or a different join method, avoids repeating the scan.

staleStatistics.title: Statistics on {{table}} look out of date
staleStatistics.why: The planner expected {{estimated}} rows but {{actual}} came back (off by {{factor}}x). Bad estimates can pick a poor join order or method.

sortSpill.title: The sort spilled to disk
sortSpill.why: The sort used about {{spaceKb}} KB on disk because it did not fit in memory ({{workMem}}). Sorting in memory is much faster.

hashSpill.title: The hash operation spilled to disk
hashSpill.why: The hash table did not fit in memory and was split into {{batches}} batches written to disk.

fullScanReview.title: Review the full scan of {{table}}
fullScanReview.why: {{table}} is read in full ({{rows}} rows). If the query needs only a few rows, a filter or an index may help; if it needs most rows, this scan is fine.

existingIndexUnused.title: An existing index on {{table}} is not used
existingIndexUnused.why: The index {{index}} could serve this query but the planner chose another path. Check statistics and the shape of the condition.

pgBitmapLossy.title: The bitmap scan on {{table}} became lossy
pgBitmapLossy.why: The bitmap did not fit in memory ({{workMem}}): {{lossy}} pages are lossy and {{recheck}} rows were rechecked. Raising work_mem keeps the bitmap exact.

pgHeapFetches.title: The index-only scan on {{table}} still visits the table
pgHeapFetches.why: {{fetches}} rows needed a trip to the table because the visibility map is not up to date. A VACUUM refreshes it.

pgFunctionOnColumn.title: The function on {{column}} prevents index use on {{table}}
pgFunctionOnColumn.why: The condition applies {{function}} to the column, so a plain index on {{column}} cannot be used and {{examined}} rows are read. An index on the expression, or a rewritten condition, fixes it.

implicitConversion.title: Implicit type conversion on {{column}}
implicitConversion.why: The comparison converts types implicitly, which can stop the index on {{column}} from being used. Compare values of the same type.

pgParallelNotLaunched.title: Parallel workers were planned but not launched
pgParallelNotLaunched.why: {{planned}} workers were planned and {{launched}} started. The server may be out of parallel worker slots.

pgJitOverhead.title: JIT compilation cost more than it saved
pgJitOverhead.why: JIT spent {{jit}} ms compiling. For short queries this is usually pure overhead.

pgColdCache.title: Most pages were read from disk
pgColdCache.why: Many pages were not in the cache, so the timing may be higher than a repeated run. Run the plan again to compare.

pgNotInSubplan.title: NOT IN with a subquery is slow
pgNotInSubplan.why: NOT IN is evaluated row by row against the subquery. NOT EXISTS gives the same result for non-null values and can use a hashed anti join.

mysqlPossibleKeysUnused.title: MySQL ignored the candidate indexes on {{table}}
mysqlPossibleKeysUnused.why: Candidate indexes exist but none was chosen. Check statistics, the condition and the data types.

mysqlTempTableGroup.title: A temporary table is built for the grouping
mysqlTempTableGroup.why: GROUP BY or ORDER BY needs a temporary table. An index in the grouping order avoids it.

mysqlJoinBuffer.title: A join uses the join buffer instead of an index
mysqlJoinBuffer.why: The join on {{table}} has no usable index and falls back to a block nested loop or hash join. An index on the join column helps.

mysqlIndexMerge.title: Several indexes are merged for one table
mysqlIndexMerge.why: The server merges more than one index on {{table}}. A single composite index is often faster.

mssqlMissingIndex.title: SQL Server suggests a missing index on {{table}}
mssqlMissingIndex.why: The optimizer reported an index that would lower the cost of this query. Treat it as a hint, not a rule: it ignores your other queries.

mssqlKeyLookup.title: Key Lookup on {{table}} runs for many rows
mssqlKeyLookup.why: Each row found in the index needs a second read of the table. Adding the needed columns as INCLUDE columns removes the lookup.

mssqlNoJoinPredicate.title: A join has no join predicate
mssqlNoJoinPredicate.why: The plan joins two inputs without a condition, which multiplies their rows. Check the ON clause.

mssqlNoStatistics.title: Statistics are missing on {{table}}
mssqlNoStatistics.why: The optimizer had no statistics on {{columns}} and guessed the row count. Creating them improves the estimates.

mssqlExcessiveGrant.title: The memory grant is much larger than needed
mssqlExcessiveGrant.why: The query asked for far more memory than it used, which can make other queries wait.

oracleCartesian.title: A Cartesian join was used
oracleCartesian.why: Two row sources are joined without a condition. Check the join conditions of the query.

oracleIndexSkipScan.title: An index skip scan was used on {{table}}
oracleIndexSkipScan.why: The leading column of the index is not in the condition, so the index is probed many times. An index starting with the filtered column is cheaper.

mongoCollscan.title: Full collection scan on {{collection}}
mongoCollscan.why: The query reads every document of {{collection}}. An index on the filtered fields lets MongoDB read only the matches.

mongoExaminedRatio.title: Many documents are examined for few results
mongoExaminedRatio.why: MongoDB examined far more keys or documents than it returned. A more selective or compound index narrows the work.

mongoBlockingSort.title: The sort cannot use an index
mongoBlockingSort.why: MongoDB sorts the documents in memory. An index matching the filter and the sort order avoids that.

mongoLookupNoIndex.title: $lookup joins without an index
mongoLookupNoIndex.why: The joined collection has no index on the foreign field, so every lookup scans it.

mongoUnanchoredRegex.title: The regular expression cannot use an index well
mongoUnanchoredRegex.why: A regex that is not anchored at the start must scan all index keys. Anchor it with ^ or use a text index.

chPrimaryKeyUnused.title: The filter does not use the primary key of {{table}}
chPrimaryKeyUnused.why: The condition is not on a prefix of the ORDER BY key, so most granules are read. Filtering on the key prefix, or adding a skip index, reduces reads.

chPartitionNotPruned.title: No partitions were skipped on {{table}}
chPartitionNotPruned.why: The query does not filter on the partition key, so every partition is read.

chSkipIndexUseless.title: A skip index did not reduce reads
chSkipIndexUseless.why: The data skipping index on {{table}} did not exclude any granules for this query.

chFinal.title: FINAL makes the read slower
chFinal.why: FINAL merges rows at query time. Consider deduplicating differently if the table is large.

chJoinRightLarge.title: The right side of the join is large
chJoinRightLarge.why: ClickHouse loads the right table of a join into memory. Put the smaller table on the right.

crdbIndexRecommendation.title: CockroachDB recommends an index on {{table}}
crdbIndexRecommendation.why: The optimizer listed an index that would speed this query up. Check it against your other queries before creating it.

crdbMissingStats.title: Statistics are missing on {{table}}
crdbMissingStats.why: The plan is built without table statistics, so row counts are guesses.

tidbPseudoStats.title: TiDB used pseudo statistics on {{table}}
tidbPseudoStats.why: Real statistics are missing, so TiDB estimates with fixed guesses. Run ANALYZE TABLE.

nonSargablePredicate.title: The condition on {{column}} cannot use an index
nonSargablePredicate.why: Applying {{function}} to {{column}} hides it from the index. Rewrite the condition so the column stands alone.

leadingWildcardLike.title: LIKE with a leading wildcard on {{column}}
leadingWildcardLike.why: A pattern such as {{pattern}} cannot use a B-tree index. A trigram or full-text index can.

orAcrossColumns.title: OR across different columns
orAcrossColumns.why: An OR over different columns often forces a full scan. UNION ALL of two indexed queries can use an index for each part.

selectStar.title: SELECT * returns every column
selectStar.why: Reading all columns widens every row and blocks index-only access. List only the columns you need.

largeOffset.title: A large OFFSET reads rows it throws away
largeOffset.why: OFFSET {{offset}} still reads and discards that many rows. Keyset pagination starts right after the last row seen.

notInSubquery.title: NOT IN with a subquery on {{column}}
notInSubquery.why: NOT IN returns no rows if the subquery yields a NULL, and it is often slow. NOT EXISTS is safer and can use an anti join.

typeMismatch.title: Type mismatch on {{column}}
typeMismatch.why: The value is compared with a column of another type, so the index on {{column}} may be skipped. Use a value of the column's type.

unknown.title: Optimisation advice
unknown.why: This advice comes from a newer version of the advisor. See the evidence and actions below.

caveats.estimateFromExpression: The estimate comes from an expression or CTE, so it may not reflect stale statistics.
caveats.estimatedOnly: Based on estimates only; run Analyze to confirm.
caveats.heapFetchesReplica: On a replica, heap fetches can stay high until the primary vacuums.
caveats.indexForSortSpill: An index in sort order may remove the sort instead of just tuning memory.
caveats.keysetNeedsUniqueOrder: Keyset pagination needs a unique, stable ordering (add the primary key as a tie-breaker).
caveats.metadataUnavailable: Existing indexes could not be checked; the suggestion may duplicate one.
caveats.semanticsDiffer: The rewritten statement behaves differently with NULLs; check the results.
caveats.spillEstimate: The memory figure is an estimate.
caveats.vacuumIo: VACUUM reads the table and adds I/O load.
caveats.workMemEstimate: The work_mem value is estimated from page counts.
caveats.workMemMultiplies: work_mem applies per sort or hash node and per parallel worker; raise it for this session only.
caveats.writeOverhead: Every index slows down inserts and updates and uses disk space.
caveats.expressionMustBeImmutable: The expression must be immutable to be indexed.
caveats.extendsIndex: Replaces or extends an existing index; drop the old one only after checking other queries.
caveats.rebuildKeepsOptions: The rebuild keeps the key order and INCLUDE columns of the old index, but check its compression, fill factor and filegroup — they are not read here.
caveats.onlineDdlMayFail: Online index creation may fail or wait on long transactions.
caveats.selectivityHigh: The condition keeps most rows, so an index may not help.
caveats.serverSuggestion: Suggested by the server from this query alone; review before creating.
caveats.planMayBeStale: This plan is old; data and indexes may have changed since.
caveats.ambiguousTable: The table name matches more than one object; check which one is meant.
caveats.coversOtherAdvice: This index also covers another suggestion.
caveats.largeTableBuild: Large table ({{rows}} rows): building the index takes time, disk space and I/O.
caveats.requiresExtension: Requires the {{extension}} extension, which must be installed by an administrator.
caveats.cartesianMayBeIntended: A cartesian product may be intended here; confirm before adding a join condition.
caveats.coveredByAnotherIndex: The suggested index is already covered by the wider index proposed in another card.
caveats.derivedTableMaterialized: The derived table is materialized; an index on it cannot be created, rewrite the query instead.
caveats.descendingIndexIgnored: This server parses DESC in an index but stores it ascending, so the order may still need a sort.
caveats.dropAfterVerify: Drop the replaced index only after the new one is in use and the plan is confirmed.
caveats.finalPartitionSemantics: FINAL merges per partition; check that the query results stay the same.
caveats.fullScanMayAvoidSort: A full scan may be cheaper than the index when the sort can be avoided.
caveats.fullscanIo: Full scans cost I/O and can evict hot pages from the cache.
caveats.fulltextSemantics: Full-text search matches words, not substrings, so results can differ.
caveats.includeDropped: The INCLUDE columns were dropped because this server or column type does not allow them.
caveats.includeTrimmed: The INCLUDE list was shortened to keep the index small.
caveats.indexKeysFromSeek: The existing index keys were read from the seek predicate, not from the catalog.
caveats.jitHelpsOlap: JIT can help long analytic queries; disable it only for short ones.
caveats.joinSizesFromGranules: Join sizes are estimated from granule counts, not from row counts.
caveats.memoryGrantFeedback: Memory grant feedback may fix the grant after a few runs.
caveats.memoryQuotaPerQuery: The memory quota applies to each query; check the total across concurrent queries.
caveats.missingIndexHint: The suggestion comes from the server missing-index hint and ignores other queries.
caveats.noDdlForDialect: No ready-made DDL is generated for this database.
caveats.notInTransaction: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.
caveats.offlineIndexBuild: The index is built offline and blocks writes while it runs.
caveats.optimizerLikelyRight: The optimizer probably chose correctly; compare before forcing an index.
caveats.prefixIndex: Column {{column}} is indexed by a prefix because of its type.
caveats.projectionStorage: A projection stores a second copy of the data and uses extra disk.
caveats.skipIndexOnly: Only a skip index is possible here; it filters granules, not rows.
caveats.skipIndexTypeGuess: The skip index type is a guess from the filter shape; test alternatives.
caveats.sortBufferPerThread: The sort buffer is allocated per connection; a large value multiplies across sessions.
caveats.transientLoad: The load is transient and may not reproduce on the next run.
caveats.unionAllSemantics: UNION ALL keeps duplicates; confirm that is acceptable.
